reference.notes: Judged as jaxa_30p30n_a5p5 is; the generator's own criterion is CL on the level of JAXA L3's size (340 cells per chord, 275k cells against 261k) within 0.5 % of this code on JAXA's L3, and CL monotone in the level. The levels refine the walls only (cells per chord), so cells grow about as cells per chord, not its square.
